items.source: Note: As of 6.2, this will enforce non-null result values as originally designed (just accidentally not enforced before). (never null)
items.translation: 注意：自 6.2 版本起，将按最初设计强制要求非空结果值（之前只是意外未强制执行）。（永远不为 `null`）

items.source: Retrieve a single value result, if available, as an Optional handle.
items.translation: 如果可用，则检索单个值结果作为 `Optional` 处理程序。

items.source:
Retrieve the result as a list of rows,
retaining the order from the original database result.
items.translation: 将结果检索为行列表，保留原始数据库结果的顺序。

items.source: Retrieve the result as a row set.

Retrieve a single column result,
retaining the order from the original database result.
items.translation: 检索单列结果，并保留原始数据库结果的顺序。

items.source:
a detached row set representation
of the original database result
items.translation: 原始数据库结果的已分离行集表示

items.source:
a (potentially empty) list of rows,
with each result row represented as a map of
case-insensitive column names to column values
items.translation: 一个（可能为空）的行列表，其中每个结果行表示为从大小写不敏感的列名到列值的映射。

items.source:
the result row represented as a map of
case-insensitive column names to column values
items.translation: 作为列名（不区分大小写）到列值的映射表示的结果行

items.source:
a (potentially empty) list of rows, with each
row represented as its single column value
items.translation: 一个（可能为空）的行列表，其中每一行由其单个列值表示。

items.source: an Optional handle with the single column value from the single row
items.translation: 一个包含单行单列值的 Optional 句柄。

items.source: A specification for simple result queries.
